verdict.rationale: Fivetran publishes its pricing model. It is usage-based, billed monthly on monthly active rows, with a documented free-plan MAR allowance and annual-contract discounts. However, nothing in the evidence shows a way to estimate a new source's cost before connecting it. Community users concretely report MAR billing as unpredictable, with spikes and inflated record counts, and one user says costs are only discoverable during the post-setup period. Missing for 10: a documented pre-connection cost estimator or per-source cost guidance, published per-MAR rates, and independent confirmation that bills are predictable.

support.subject: As a data platform lead, the pricing model is published and predictable — I can estimate what a new source costs before connecting it

citations.quote: Pricing is usage-based. You are charged based on what you use each month.
